state:
Goal `core-str-3-3`: `Core\Str::split` has every feature proof on disk: description, three
examples, attack, bench record, two Rust tests with its `covers:` marker, and a card in plain words.
`split` now counts its pieces first and pays for the whole list through `nvs_runtime::affordable`
and `NvsArray::try_reserve`, the way `lines_array` does. Before this, a subject of separators alone
built an array about nine times the memory limit before the breach was reported. A negative limit
no longer collects a `Vec<&str>` of every piece. Every `Core\Str` perf record was re-measured after
`str.rs` changed. `--record-perf` refused calibration twice on a busy machine and passed on the
third try. The members still owed in this goal are `startsWith`, `trim`, `trimStart`, `trimEnd`,
`wrap`, `upper` and `upperFirst`.

next.title: member proofs, file order
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs`, and each member's trees under `docs/examples/core/Str/`, `tests/hostile/core/Str/`, `benches/members/core/Str/`.

items.text: **`Core\Str::startsWith`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); a scalar result, so its bench declares `// bench: allocations 0`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:1964`

**`Core\Str::trim`, `trimStart`, `trimEnd`** — each owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); if the three share one helper, one Rust test with three `covers:` markers is enough. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:2321`

**`Core\Str::upper`, `upperFirst`, `wrap`** — each owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Check that each result is written through `built` and not a Rust `String` the budget never sees, as `replaceAll` was. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:3453`

backlog: `Core\Str::chunk`, `graphemes` and `codePoints` append one entry per piece and ask no budget, so a long subject builds its array past the memory limit before the breach is reported; `lines_array` and `split` pay first. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:2119` — owner: goal `core-str-3-3` if a slice fits, else a `# Known gaps` item in `str.rs`'s module doc.
